yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No numerical campaign date is spoken. Absolute August 22–24, 1748 dates come from YAML; the transcript independently establishes the Wednesday → Thursday → Friday progression.
yamlCheck.explanation: The following-day errands and lecture, then Friday morning’s purchases and Fausto visit, establish two calendar transitions. This matches the YAML span conditional on its opening date. Gnaeus’s historical travels, recalled circlet events, proposed rests and future upstream travel do not extend that played span.
